title: Mortal Shell II — Week 1 Update
description: Week 1 Update rollout and Hotfix 3 notes for Mortal Shell II: PC, PS5, and Xbox status (checked Sept 2, 2026).
quickAnswer: The Week 1 Update is live on PC and PS5 (PS5 rolled out Sept 1, 2026); Xbox is officially delayed as of Sept 2, 2026. A PC-only Hotfix 3 (Sept 1) followed the Week 1 Update and addressed several targeted bugs — see the PC crash guide for details.

faq.question: Is the Week 1 Update live on PC, PS5, and Xbox?
faq.answer: PC: live. PS5: live (rolled out Sept 1, 2026). Xbox: officially delayed per the last confirmation — status checked Sept 2, 2026.

faq.question: What did Hotfix 3 change?
faq.answer: Hotfix 3 (Sept 1, PC Steam) targeted several specific bugs and fixes; it is a PC hotfix and does not resolve every crash or performance issue — see the PC crash guide for details.

faq.question: Where can I find the full Week 1 changelog and other updates?
faq.answer: See the updates hub: /mortal-shell-ii/updates/ for the full changelog and linked posts.

faq.question: I'm still getting crashes or poor performance after the update — what should I check?
faq.answer: See the PC crash and performance guide at /mortal-shell-ii/crashing-pc/ for post-patch troubleshooting and a list of what Hotfix 3 did and did not fix.

faq.question: When did the PS5 rollout happen?

articleMarkdown:
## Quick answer

The Week 1 Update is live on PC and PS5 (PS5 rolled out Sept 1, 2026); Xbox is officially delayed as of Sept 2, 2026. A PC-only Hotfix 3 (Sept 1) followed the Week 1 Update and addressed several targeted bugs — see the PC crash guide for details.

## Platform availability / Current rollout

- PC — Week 1 Update available.
- PS5 — Week 1 Update available (rolled out Sept 1, 2026).
- Xbox — Officially delayed / coming as soon as possible. Status checked Sept 2, 2026.

See the updates hub for the full changelog: /mortal-shell-ii/updates/
